violated_contract: A recorder or detector that must see every change of an OS-owned state must not rely on OS change notifications alone. On macOS 27, CoreAudio per-process IsRunningInput/IsRunningOutput property listeners registered on an already-listed process never fired: a call-boundary probe run through a full Zoom call and a Telegram call recorded no microphone events, while process-list removals still arrived, so the trace looked healthy and was empty.
canonical_prevention: Treat the state read as ground truth: poll it at the resolution the consumer needs and deduplicate edges, keeping listeners only as a latency hint. Check every listener registration's status and surface failures. Validate the recorder against a real state change of an already-running process, not only process arrival.
